highlights.reason_zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 已全平台开放，成本阶梯会直接影响高吞吐与长上下文架构。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Haiku 5.5 is broadly available, and its pricing tiers directly affect high-volume and long-context architectures.

highlights.reason_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2 用一个开放小模型覆盖多模态检索，是最直接可复测的本地部署变化。
highlights.reason_en: EmbeddingGemma 2 covers multimodal retrieval with one small open model, making it the most directly testable local-deployment change.

highlights.reason_zh: Anthropic CVP 把高风险 cyber 能力、身份核验和持续监测绑定为一套访问制度。
highlights.reason_en: Anthropic CVP binds high-risk cyber capability, identity verification and ongoing monitoring into one access regime.

highlights.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 本地 sandbox 进入 GA，使 coding agent 的权限边界成为可立即采用的默认控制。
highlights.reason_en: GitHub Copilot local sandboxing reaches GA, making coding-agent permission boundaries an immediately adoptable control.

highlights.reason_zh: Liquid d1 把路由与审核从 token 生成改成单次结构化决策，值得验证延迟与校准。
highlights.reason_en: Liquid d1 moves routing and review from token generation to one structured decision, warranting latency and calibration tests.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；本轮处置 13 项实质变化，并完成 PixelUMM、KaliBench 与 Argo-Bench 三项到期复核。召回自检补录 openTPU 与 EMA Lightning。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read. The run dispositioned 13 material changes and completed due reviews for PixelUMM, KaliBench and Argo-Bench. Recall audit recovered openTPU and EMA Lightning.
